headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录232篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究159篇, 开源项目38篇, 模型发布35篇。热门标签：Agent（40篇）。其中16%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ backnotprop /plannotator：The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code,

▸ GoogleChrome /modern-web-guidance-src：Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

▸ ChromeDevTools /chrome-devtools-mcp：Chrome DevTools for coding agents

▸ alibaba /open-code-review：Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: det

▸ QwenLM /qwen-code：An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
